run_whisper_translator: run the WhisperTranslator to record audio from microphone and transcribe speech to text
create_whisper_translator_instance: create a WhisperTranslator instance that initializes VAD, loads the Whisper base model on CUDA
record_audio_with_vad: record audio from a USB microphone using voice activity detection to auto-stop on silence
translate_audio_offline: translate recorded audio to text using a locally loaded Whisper model with language detection
translate_audio_online: translate recorded audio to text using the OpenAI Cloud Whisper API with an API key
